inputs.text: Look, once again we see left-wing municipal politicians undermining the rule of law and coddling lawlessness right in our own backyard. On Wednesday night, Phoenix city leaders approved a radical new plan that slaps restrictive handcuffs on ICE and other federal law enforcement agencies, barring them from properly utilizing city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports that these local officials are actively scheming to obstruct federal immigration enforcement, choosing to protect open borders over public safety, national sovereignty, and the hardworking citizens who expect their leaders to uphold basic order. It’s an absolute disgrace that puts progressive ideology ahead of the safety of our communities.
